SELF-HOSTING · DOCUMENTED BUILD

Umbrel Bitcoin Node

A Bitcoin node experiment hosted in an UmbrelOS virtual machine.

UmbrelOSBitcoin CoreProxmoxLightning

System at a glance

Proxmox VM→UmbrelOS→Bitcoin Core→Bitcoin network

What I built

  • Installed UmbrelOS in a virtual machine and worked with the Bitcoin node application.
  • Explored CPU and memory allocation, database cache, and a virtual disk around 1.3 TB.
  • Investigated Lightning and how its node operations differ from simply running Bitcoin Core.

Troubleshooting notes

Guest disk capacity

Worked through a case where increasing virtual disk capacity did not immediately make all space usable inside the guest. Storage resizing was later reported resolved.

Ephemeral terminal changes

Umbrel warns that terminal modifications may not survive updates; persistent configuration requires care.

What I learned

  • Node synchronization depends on storage and I/O as well as CPU and memory.
  • Separate VM disk size, partition size, and filesystem size when checking capacity.
Documentation compiled from my project notes and shared troubleshooting history. Commands, final configuration files, and screenshots will be added as they are verified. The diagram is a simplified project overview.
